features.title: Production Harness bootstrap and self-validation
features.user_visible_behavior: A new session can validate repository state and run the standard verification command from any supported platform.
features.evidence: pnpm exec vitest run scripts/harness/validate-harness.test.ts: 3 passed; pnpm exec vitest run scripts/harness/harness-init-lib.test.ts: 5 passed; HARNESS_SKIP_INSTALL=1 pnpm harness:init: exited 0 with pnpm format:check, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm test (10 passed).
features.notes: Bootstrap state and verification evidence were validated on 2026-08-05.

features.title: Monorepo and TypeScript toolchain baseline
features.user_visible_behavior: The repository installs, typechecks, formats, and runs the core package tests through stable pnpm commands.
features.evidence: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/test/index.test.ts: 2 passed; pnpm typecheck: passed; pnpm format:check: all files matched.
features.notes: Core identity function is intentionally minimal; provider contracts are a later feature.

features.title: Official Cline CLI process lifecycle driver
features.user_visible_behavior: cline2api can start, monitor, cancel, and finish an authorized official Cline CLI process with bounded diagnostics.
verification: CLI lifecycle contract tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux
features.notes: Use only documented official CLI behavior; no internal protocol inspection.

features.title: OpenAI-compatible discovery and health endpoints
features.user_visible_behavior: Existing clients can discover cline2api and verify that its local provider endpoint is healthy.
verification: HTTP contract tests for health and model discovery
features.notes: Keep the adapter boundary compatible with existing routers.

features.title: Chat completions and SSE stream translation
features.user_visible_behavior: Clients can request non-streaming or streaming chat completions through one OpenAI-compatible contract.
verification: Contract and integration tests for non-streaming, SSE, timeout, and cancellation
features.notes: Streaming-first design; preserve cancellation and terminal error semantics.

features.title: Configuration, secret redaction, timeout, and cancellation
features.user_visible_behavior: Configuration failures are actionable and diagnostics never expose credentials or sensitive provider content.
verification: Redaction, timeout, cancellation, and malformed-configuration tests
features.notes: No secret may enter feature evidence, logs, snapshots, commits, or CI artifacts.

features.title: Plugin SDK and capability contracts
features.user_visible_behavior: Integrations can register against stable capability contracts without coupling to Cline internals.
verification: Plugin contract, compatibility, and isolation tests
features.notes: One core adapter path; integrations must not create divergent protocol implementations.

features.title: 9Router adapter package
features.user_visible_behavior: 9Router can use cline2api through its supported provider interface.
features.notes: Do not compete with or reimplement 9Router routing behavior.

features.title: OmniRoute adapter package
features.user_visible_behavior: OmniRoute can use cline2api through its supported provider interface.
features.notes: Do not compete with or reimplement OmniRoute routing behavior.

features.title: OpenCodeX adapter package
features.user_visible_behavior: OpenCodeX can use cline2api through its supported provider interface.
features.notes: Do not compete with or reimplement OpenCodeX routing behavior.

features.title: Observability, diagnostics, and release CI matrix
features.user_visible_behavior: Maintainers can diagnose supported-platform failures and release reproducible packages with evidence.
verification: Cross-platform CI, diagnostics, and release reproducibility checks
features.notes: Diagnostics must remain redacted and bounded.
